en: An old sepia-toned postcard view over a snow-covered town with churches and multi‑story buildings around an open square. The image shows a panorama taken from an elevated tower, with a large church tower on the left, several spires in the background, and horse‑drawn sleds or wagons crossing the main square. The caption is printed in German in the upper right corner.
